page.title: Access & consents
page.subtitle: Only you decide who sees your children’s data, and until when. We’ll tell you about every change.
page.coNote: The owner, {owner}, manages access and consents. You can see everything here but can’t change it.
page.coNoteNoOwner: The profile owner manages access and consents. You can see everything here but can’t change it.

states.errTitle: We couldn’t load the access list
states.errBody: Nothing has changed: tutor access and your consents work as before. Check your internet connection and try again.
states.noKidsBody: Access and consents are set for each child separately. Add your child first.

req.title: Access requests
req.sub: A tutor can only ask. Whether to grant access is always your call.
req.expiresIn: expires on its own in {n} days
req.sees: They will see wave results and error types. ID numbers, your phone number and your other children stay hidden.
req.approvedNote: {name} is now listed under “Who can see”. Access closes by itself when the term ends.
req.declinedNote: {name} can’t ask to see {child}’s reports again this season.
req.none: No new requests. If a tutor asks for access, you’ll get an SMS and the request will appear here.

who.title: Who can see
who.sub: People who can see {child}’s reports right now.
who.ownerDesc: Signs consents, grants access and can request data deletion.
who.coDesc: Sees reports but can’t change access or consents.
who.transferPendingDesc: You stay the owner until {name} confirms by SMS.
who.scope: Wave results and error types · until {date}
who.revokedDesc: {child}’s history stays with them. {name} can no longer see it.
who.suspendedDesc: Access is paused for now · until {date}
who.foot: Tutor access always has an end date and closes by itself.
who.noEducators: No tutor can see {child}’s reports yet.
who.inviteSub: The other parent sees reports but can’t change anything. The invitation goes by SMS and is valid for 7 days.

log.title: Change log
log.sub: Every change is sent to the child’s guardians.

cons.title: Consents
cons.sub: Set separately for {child}. Only one is required — the rest are up to you.
cons.subReadOnly: Only the profile owner can change consents.
cons.warnBody: Without this consent {child} can’t take waves, no new reports are made and tutors stop seeing results. Earlier results are kept.
cons.paused: Measurement is paused. Turn the consent back on and {child} picks up from the next wave.

del.title: Delete data
del.sub: You can ask us to delete {child}’s profile completely. We do it by anonymising it.
del.gone1: Name, family name and date of birth
del.gone4: Access for tutors and the co-guardian
del.keptD: Answers to questions, linked to no one. They feed the question statistics: each question’s difficulty is calculated from them, which keeps other children’s results accurate.
del.doneD: Done by {date}. We’ll send an SMS when it’s complete. Until then you can cancel the request.
del.doneDReadOnly: Done by {date}. Only the profile owner can cancel the request.
del.readOnly: Only the profile owner can request data deletion.

dlg.declineD: They won’t be able to ask for {child}’s reports again this season. They’ll only see “request not accepted”, with no reason given.
dlg.revokeD: They’ll stop seeing {child}’s reports and new results. The history stays with {child} — if you later give access to another tutor, nothing is lost. {name} will be notified.
dlg.transferD: A profile always has exactly one owner. The owner signs consents, grants access to tutors and can request data deletion.
dlg.transferL1: {name} becomes the owner once they confirm by SMS.
dlg.transferL2: You become a co-guardian: you’ll see reports but can’t change anything.
dlg.transferL3: Current consents and tutor access stay as they are.
dlg.removeD: They’ll stop seeing {child}’s reports straight away. You can invite them again later.
dlg.delD: This can’t be undone. Reports and history will be gone and all access closes at once. Anonymous answers remain only for question statistics.

empty.title: For now, only you can see this data
empty.body: Nobody has access and there are no new requests. If a tutor wants to see your child’s results, they’ll send you an invitation or a request — the decision is always yours.
empty.s1D: A link arrives by SMS, or a request appears on this page.
empty.s2D: Approve or decline. A declined tutor can’t ask again this season.
empty.s3D: It closes by itself at the end of the school year — {date}.

errors.LINK_STATE: This access has already changed. The page has been refreshed — please check again.
errors.VALID_UNTIL_INVALID: The end date must be after today and no later than the end of the season.
errors.ALREADY_GUARDIAN: This person can already see your child’s profile.
errors.PHONE_INVALID: Enter an Uzbek phone number, for example 90 123 45 67.
errors.NOT_A_CO_GUARDIAN: Ownership can only go to a current co-guardian.
errors.TRANSFER_PENDING: An ownership offer is already waiting for an answer. Cancel it first.
errors.ANONYMISATION_PENDING: Deletion has been requested for this child, so nothing can be changed.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This no longer exists. The page has been refreshed.

consentsPage.title: Consents
consentsPage.subtitle: Consents are set for each child separately. You can withdraw them at any time.
consentsPage.emptyBody: Consents are given when you add a child. Add your child and manage them here.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.subtitle: You can ask us to delete your child’s data completely.
privacyPage.consentsNote: Withdrawing consents lives on the Consents page.
